title: Product Bundle
content: Build product bundle/kit display. Bundle card: hero image of bundle or composite, bundle name, included products list with thumbnails. Pricing: individual prices crossed out, bundle price, "Save X%" badge. Product details: expandable list showing each item. Add to cart: single button adds entire bundle. Customization: optional variant selection per item if applicable. Alternative: "Build Your Own Bundle" with product picker.

variants.simple: Create product bundle display with combined pricing.
variants.detailed: Build product bundle/kit display. Bundle card: hero image of bundle or composite, bundle name, included products list with thumbnails. Pricing: individual prices crossed out, bundle price, "Save X%" badge. Product details: expandable list showing each item. Add to cart: single button adds entire bundle. Customization: optional variant selection per item if applicable. Alternative: "Build Your Own Bundle" with product picker.
variants.advanced: Build comprehensive product bundle display with various bundle types. Bundle card/section: prominent display on PDP or dedicated bundle pages. Visual layout: large hero image showing bundle contents arranged attractively, or composite image with product cutouts. Badge: "Bundle & Save", "Value Set", "Kit" badge in corner. Bundle title: descriptive name ("Complete Skincare Routine", "Starter Kit", "Gaming Bundle"). Included products: vertical or horizontal list of included items. Each item: thumbnail image (w-16 h-16), product name (truncated), individual retail price, link to individual product page, variant info if specific variant included (e.g., "Size M", "Color: Black"). Pricing display: "If purchased separately: $X" crossed out total, "Bundle Price: $Y" in large text, "You Save: $Z (X%)" highlighted in green badge. Per-item breakdown: optional expandable showing bundle allocation per item. Variant selection: if bundle allows variant choice per item (e.g., size selection), show variant selectors per item within bundle, update bundle image/price if variants affect it. Add to Cart: prominent "Add Bundle to Cart - $Y" button, adds all items at once, loading state, success feedback. Quantity: bundle quantity selector if multiple bundles can be purchased. Limited availability: "Only X bundles available" scarcity indicator. Bundle types supported: Fixed bundle (all items predetermined), Configurable bundle (select variants), BOGO (Buy One Get One), Build Your Own (select X items from category). Build Your Own Bundle: product picker interface, select X of Y products, running total and savings displayed, "Add to Bundle" per product, visual checklist of selections. Bundle-only items: some products may be bundle-exclusive, noted with badge. Cross-sell: "Complete Your Bundle" suggesting additional items. Bundle comparison: if multiple bundle tiers, comparison showing what's included in each. Subscription bundle: monthly bundle option with recurring delivery. Gift bundle: option to send bundle as gift with gift options. Inventory: show if any bundle component is low stock or out of stock (affects whole bundle availability). Mobile: stack products vertically, sticky add to cart. Accessibility: clear structure, bundle contents properly grouped and labeled, pricing clearly associated.
